+#!/bin/bash
+set -o errexit
+set -o nounset
+set -o pipefail
+
+WEB_ROOT="html.spec.whatwg.org"
+DEPLOY_USER="annevankesteren"
+
+SERVER="75.119.197.251"
+SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY="ssh-rsa "
+
+SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
+
+# Environment variables set by CI
+ENCRYPTION_LABEL=${ENCRYPTION_LABEL:-}
+TRAVIS_PULL_REQUEST=${TRAVIS_PULL_REQUEST:-false}
+
+if [[ "$ENCRYPTION_LABEL" == "" ]]; then
+    echo "Missing ENCRYPTION_LABEL environment variable; exiting"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+# Get and dependencies
+git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/whatwg/html-build.git ../html-build
+git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/whatwg/wattsi.git ../wattsi
+curl -O https://sideshowbarker.net/nightlies/jar/vnu.jar
+
+# Work in the parent directory
+cd ..
+
+# Build Wattsi
+cd wattsi
+./build.sh
+cd bin
+PATH=$(pwd):$PATH
+cd ../..
+
+# Build the spec into the out directory
+./html-build/build.sh
+
+# Conformance-check the result
+/usr/lib/jvm/java-8-oracle/jre/bin/java -jar vnu.jar --skip-non-html ./html-build/output

body:
With Ubuntu's PPA, though, it's possible:
```
add-apt-repository ppa:webupd8team/java &&
apt-get update &&
apt-get install oracle-java8-installer
```
but it will ask you to accept the license on first install.

To workaround that (not sure about legal side of this though):
```
echo oracle-java8-installer shared/accepted-oracle-license-v1-1 select true | sudo /usr/bin/debconf-set-selections
```
[source](http://www.webupd8.org/2012/09/install-oracle-java-8-in-ubuntu-via-ppa.html)
